title: Handle lock release errors in pack operations
description:
**Severity: HIGH**

**File**: `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go:1188-1193`

**Issue**: Lock release errors are silently ignored in `acquirePackLocks()`:
```go
if err := client.acquireLock(ctx, packLock, owner, 60*time.Second); err != nil {
    _ = client.releaseLock(ctx, global, owner)  // line 1188
    return func() {}, err
}
return func() {
    _ = client.releaseLock(ctx, packLock, owner)  // line 1192
    _ = client.releaseLock(ctx, global, owner)    // line 1193
}, nil
```

If lock release fails, the resource remains locked, potentially blocking all future pack operations until the lock TTL expires.

**Fix**: Log warnings on lock release failures so operators know when manual intervention may be needed.
definitionOfDone: Lock release errors logged with slog.Warn including lock name and owner

implementationPlan.description: Replace the 3 blank-identifier lock release calls in `acquirePackLocks` (lines 1188, 1192, 1193) with `if err := client.releaseLock(...); err != nil { slog.Warn("pack: failed to release lock", "lock", lockName, "owner", owner, "error", err) }`.
Run `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
